orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: Explanation of orchestration and debugging in computer systems
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
• Software orchestration refers to automatically managing and arranging multiple computer programs or tasks so they work together smoothly like an orchestra.

• Debugging is the step-by-step process of finding, tracking, and fixing mistakes or errors (called bugs) in computer software.

• Orchestration debugging means checking logs and system connections to find and fix failure points when multiple automated computer systems interact with each other.
